blocks.text:
Enjoy the breathtaking view as your plane descends over Rio de Janeiro, the “Marvellous City”, where lush green hills, turquoise sea, sandy beaches and high-rise neighbourhoods blend in a unique harmony of life. You are met at the airport and transferred to your hotel, passing colonial-style buildings and the world-famous beachfront.

The natural beauty of Rio, framed by the Atlantic rainforest, sits alongside everything that makes a Latin American city so vibrant. A stroll along the mosaic promenade of Copacabana reveals the daily life of the cariocas, Rio’s locals: a refreshing caipirinha as the waves break on the shore, a lively football match on the sand and crowds relaxing on the golden beaches.

In the evening, a welcome dinner at Marius Degustare, a renowned seafood restaurant decorated in the style of a sunken ship.
